content: Items can be returned or exchanged within 30 days of delivery if unworn and in original packaging. Exchanges are free; refunds take 5-7 business days after we receive the item.
Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days and is free on orders over $75. Orders under $75 have a flat $6.50 shipping fee.
In-store boot fittings and gear consultations can be booked at the Downtown branch, Tue-Sat 10am-6pm, in 30-minute slots.
